questions.title: Before Core Congas was an institution
questions.prompt: In the March 2025 origin-story discussion, what did Nico say he originally made that chat to do?
options: Organize a permanent smaller friend group
Get a few people to a cong earlier
Choose the next Noodle group-chat name
Coordinate a surprise birthday party
questions.explanation: It began as logistics, not a founding constitution. Nico said he wanted a few people there earlier and had no intention of making it an ongoing chat. Jimmy remembered the original ‘BVH penis advisors’ name; people were also recalling different Fourth of July gatherings.

receipts.text: Nico wasn’t the og called BVH penis advisors and it was me you Zach D Nathan Quincy because you said “someone pls get here directly at 5 so I don’t have to cong alone with BVH”
Yeah bruh I made the chat cuz we were having a semi big cong and I think I wanted to invite a few people earlier
No intentions of it actually being a chat I just wanted to notify the folks

questions.title: A normal greeting, eventually
questions.prompt: Jimmy posted about throwing a stinkbug in the toilet and pooping on it. What did he then edit that announcement to say?
options: Wrong chat
Sup
Never mind
Good morning gentlemen
questions.explanation: The entire stinkbug-toilet announcement became ‘Sup.’ An impressively casual replacement for the original report.

receipts.text: Just saw a stinkbug on my wall as I was bouta poop so I grabbed it off the wall and threw it in the toilet and pooped on it
Edited to “Sup”

questions.title: It survived the microwave. Then what?
questions.prompt: Nico said a fly survived two minutes in the microwave. What did Jimmy suggest making it listen to next?
options: A Charlie science voice note
The entire Weezer discography
The new KSI song on repeat
A recording of Zach farting
questions.explanation: Jimmy's follow-up was to tape AirPods next to it and make it listen to KSI's new song on repeat. Nico supplied the accidental microwave story; Jimmy supplied this particular escalation.

receipts.text: What the fuck I just accidentally microwaved a fly for 2 minutes and it survived
Dawg how
Now tape it to the wall and tape AirPods next to it and make it listen to ksi new song on repeat

questions.title: A thriving national economy
questions.prompt: According to Nathan's mock Noodle-government economics, what was the nation's main export?
options: Jimmy's milk
Charlie's textbooks
Zach's fart recordings
Ronan's mixtapes
questions.explanation: ‘jimmys milk.’ Nathan credited it with sustaining the entire Noodle chat-government economy.

receipts.text: Everyone knows noodle chat government economy thrives off its main export; jimmys milk

questions.title: Constitutional law, Noodle edition
questions.prompt: Nico's 2022 ‘no exclusion’ handbook rule resurfaced in 2023 as a very specific veto. What did he claim wasn't allowed?
options: Changing the group-chat name without a vote
Having a cong when Nico couldn't come
Hosting two congs in the same weekend
Inviting anyone outside the original group
questions.explanation: The 2022 version banned exclusion. In 2023, Nico invoked that principle to announce that congs couldn't happen without him. Charlie then contributed the very precise ‘The noodle handbook doesn’t not exist.’

receipts.text: The first rule of the noodle handbook is that exclusion is not allowed
What the fuck is wrong with you guys I thought we all agreed that you aren’t allowed to have congs if I can’t come
The noodle handbook doesn’t not exist

questions.title: Uncredited audio contribution
questions.prompt: What made Jimmy say he had to restart recording his presentation the second he began?
options: His laptop played a fart voice message
His roommate loudly pissed, then ripped a high-pitched fart
Someone in the room started reciting the Noodle handbook
He realized he'd been recording the wrong screen
questions.explanation: His roommate supplied a loud piss followed by ‘the highest pitch fart ever.’ Jimmy's next message: ‘Had to restart after that.’ A full sound-design department, absolutely unrequested.

receipts.text: The second I start recording my presentation my roommate has a loud piss followed by the highest pitch fart ever
Had to restart after that

questions.title: That is not geometry
questions.prompt: Nico accidentally searched ‘circumcision’ at work. What was he actually trying to look up?
options: The volume of a cylinder
The area of a triangle
The circumference of a circle
The diameter of a sphere
questions.explanation: He wanted the circumference of a circle. Instead, the work search took a hard turn into circumcision, followed immediately by ‘My heart dropped.’ Nathan helpfully added ‘Circumscribe.’

receipts.text: Holy fuck I tried to look up circumference of a circle at work and I accidentally looked up circumcision
My heart dropped
Circumscribe

questions.title: One tap too many
questions.prompt: Opening poop chat at Scott was already a bad move. What did Jacky say he accidentally did next?
options: Played a voice note on full volume
Sent the picture to another chat
Tapped the poop picture and enlarged it
Turned his screen brightness all the way up
questions.explanation: He didn't just open the chat: he accidentally tapped the poop picture and enlarged it. The extra tap was the escalation in Jacky's report.

receipts.text: I not only opened poop chat at Scott but also accidentally tapped the poop pic and enlarged it

questions.title: Voice messages, but worse
questions.prompt: Nico brought up Jacky's unusual way of listening to voice messages. Jacky corrected him: it was ‘the new meta.’ What was the method?
options: Playing them at double speed
Reading a transcription without listening
Opening the same message on two phones
Watching a screen recording of the audio message
questions.explanation: A screen recording of an audio message, instead of just playing the audio message. Nico said it was one of the funniest things Jacky had said; Jacky's correction was that he'd called it ‘the new meta.’

receipts.text: One of the funniest things Jacky has said was that he’d rather watch a screen recording of an audio message than actually click the audio message
Idky that was so funny to me
No I just said it was the new meta

questions.title: A perfectly reasonable precaution
questions.prompt: Nathan reached his 666th dragon. What did he do out of superstition before hatching it?
options: Renamed it to avoid tempting fate
Made sure dragon 667 was already on the way
Waited until the clock passed midnight
Asked Charlie to hatch it for him
questions.explanation: He waited until he knew 667 was on the way. Nathan announced ‘My 666th dragon,’ added ‘Spooky,’ and explained his very specific insurance policy against the number.

receipts.text: My 666th dragon
Spooky
I waited to hatch it out of superstition until I knew 667 was on the way
